about.title: About me
about.subtitle: Entrepreneur, builder and advisor
about.description: I grew up in a small inn on the coast of Santa Catarina, Brazil. My parents ran it for 25 years without ever having a plan; in 2020, it closed. In the second month of the pandemic the question became mine: are we doing this right? I started building a system to answer it. It became Atlas, and the method I now use with more than 300 families.

leadIn.label: WHAT I DO
leadIn.thesis: I manage the wealth of high-net-worth families and build the systems that make that care scale.
leadIn.scope: Investment advisory with proprietary technology, and three SaaS built from scratch, with AI, using the same recipe.
leadIn.bridging: From the plan to the system, live.
leadIn.integration: Beyond advisory, I build complete products: data, auth, AI at the core, payments and launch. Alone, with AI, in a way that can be taught.

coreEngineering.label: What holds it up
coreEngineering.title:
Proven method.
Measurable results.
coreEngineering.p1: For more than 10 years in the financial market, I manage the wealth of those with a lot to lose: around R$ 260 million under management and more than 300 families with hands-on planning.
coreEngineering.p2: In 2020 I started building systems to solve the pains I saw in clients. Today there are three SaaS live, Atlas, Zephyr and Cria Social Club, built alone, with AI.
coreEngineering.p3: All with the same repeatable recipe: Lovable, Supabase, AI at the core, payments and launch. It is exactly the method I teach.
